excludedPredefinedFunctions.description: Optional. By default, predefined functions are included in the final model call. Some of them can be explicitly excluded from being automatically included. This can serve two purposes: 1. Using a more restricted / different action space. 2. Improving the definitions / instructions of predefined functions.

enablePromptInjectionDetection.description: Optional. Whether enable the prompt injection detection check on computer-use request.

disabledSafetyPolicies.description: Optional. Disabled safety policies for computer use.
